My understanding of Janazah was, the Community are Mashahid over the Mayith, and hence make dua for Allah's mercy etc. As for the Shaheed, then his wounds etc are witness for him etc. And his soul (inshaAllah) would be in the hearts of green birds, roaming Jannah, and you know this narration better than i do. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 7330 Country: India Title: My sister was watching a dream that me and younger brother is eating meat of the dog what was that mean in the dream? Need your answer quickly because I am very disturb about this dream. Question: Aslam u Alikum. Hope you are doing good by grace of Allah. My sister was watching a dream that me and younger brother is eating meat of the dog what was that mean in the dream? Need your answer quickly because I am very disturb about this dream. Jazakalallah Answer ID: 7330 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1454/1369=D/1429) You and your younger brother shall gain financial and material benefits from your enemies. You should refrain from unlawful wealth and observe taqwa (piety). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
